beforeSubmitPrompt.prompt: Block ONLY if this prompt is clearly requesting a NEW multi-file feature or major architectural change that would take HOURS to implement (e.g. 'implement a new authentication system', 'build a dashboard with charts', 'migrate the database layer'). Allow everything else: bug fixes, reviews, small refactors, config changes, questions, commit/sync requests, follow-ups, maintenance, single-file edits, and any prompt where the scope is unclear. When in doubt, ALLOW. The user can invoke /planner manually when they need it. Check if .cursor/harness/state.json or .cursor/harness/contract.json exist — if either exists, the harness is already active, so ALLOW.
